description.p: Tipitaka Pali Reader (TPR) is designed for reading and studying Pāḷi texts. It offers integrated dictionary support, multi-language definitions, and support for various scripts. Ideal for students of early Buddhist texts, it enables fast lookup of word meanings and root structures.

ul.li: The whole Tipitaka with commentaries and sub-commentaries, in many scripts
Translations in many languages from ePitaka, shown beneath the Pāḷi
Tap a word to see its meaning, grammar and root in several dictionaries
Search the Pāḷi and the translations, in the script you read them in
Page numbers of the Myanmar, VRI, PTS and Thai editions
Bookmarks in folders, with cloud transfer between devices

description.p: May all beings benefit from this dhamma donation!
The Digital Pāḷi Dictionary now comes complete with the app.

ul.li: DPD of October 2026 built in, with inflection tables, root and compound families and word frequency
Extensions install more reliably on devices with little memory, and take less space once installed
Five second volumes now open at their own beginning, not at the start of the first volume
The paper-page tip shows where the setting is
A note on the two TPR Indic Roman fonts for Pāḷi
Eight more translations to install: Spanish, French, Czech, Indonesian, Korean, Bengali, Marathi and Nepali
Thai Pāḷi in the Sarabun font, and Thai fixes for flash cards and dictionary lookups
A small button on the home screen when a newer version is out
The quote of the day moves on when the day changes, even with the app left open

description.p: A season of reading improvements since 3.0.1.

ul.li: X-ray: commentary links shown under the Pāḷi
A library tree, and Piṭaka and Mūla views, that follow the open book
Faster, whole-word search, with headings shown in the results
Abhidhamma handbooks included
Choice of paper for the page, and two new head-bar Roman fonts
Quote of the day and "Verses to know" on the home screen
Foldable dictionaries, smoother language installs, read-aloud fixes
Bookmarks backed up with their folders

description.p: The texts now come from ePitaka's sentence data, and translations can be added.

ul.li: Download translations in many languages and show them beneath the Pāḷi
Turn the Pāḷi and each language on or off from the quick settings
Search translations in their own script, such as Myanmar, Thai and Sinhala
A search hit opens on the page it is on
Headings sized by their level, and book text kept to a readable width
Old bookmarks, history and settings are kept on upgrade
AI search copies the translation along with the Pāḷi

description.p: TPR build 123 released. Critical index bug is fixed. jumping and highlight bug is fixed.
